title: Minimal finite graded free presentations over the two-variable polynomial ring
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ graded by total degree, and $I=(x_0,x_1)$. A minimal finite graded free presentation consists of $S$-modules $F,N$, internal decompositions $F=\bigoplus_{j\in\mathbf Z}F_j$ and $N=\bigoplus_{j\in\mathbf Z}N_j$ into additive subgroups, satisfying $S_iF_j\subseteq F_{i+j}$ and $S_iN_j\subseteq N_{i+j}$, with $N$ finitely generated as a graded module (generated by finitely many homogeneous elements), a finite homogeneous $S$-basis $(e_a)_{a\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}}$ of $F$ with degrees $d_a\in\mathbf Z$, and a surjective $S$-linear map $q:F\to N$ with $q(F_j)\subseteq N_j$ and $q^{-1}(IN)\subseteq IF$. The last condition, together with surjectivity, is equivalent to the induced map $F/IF\to N/IN$ being an isomorphism.
